summary: Server-side position and heading of a crowd proxy (ambient crowd member in Baldur's Gate / Moonrise). Written by esv::crowds::ProxyTransformSystem (per-frame update bg3.exe+0x35686B0); read by esv::crowds::DetourSystem, PatrolSystem and SpawnSystem (macOS). Born live in lower-city dialogues and item uses (only server instances).

fields.name: Position
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x35686B0 copies 8+4 bytes at +0 and +8 as one vector together with +0xC; live world coordinates (-309.9, 7.3, 17.5).

fields.name: Rotation
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x35686B0 compares fmodf(angle + 2pi, 2pi) with fmodf(*(+0xC) + 2pi, 2pi) and writes the new angle to +0xC when it changed: a heading (yaw) in radians. Live 0.06 .. -2.96.
